content: Hi how can i assist you today
Elevators arrive the moment I think a floor number. It’s as if they listen.
Elevators run on queue logic. Did you observe this at multiple buildings and times, or mainly one bank of elevators?
Late-day traffic can cluster calls, making quick arrivals more likely. Timing the average wait across a few days provides a baseline.
I’ll time five waits per day.
A small sample like that often reveals the typical range.
If mine are shorter than average?
Then it may be the building’s dispatch efficiency at that hour; the baseline will show it.
